profile.headline: SWE @ Databricks | NAC ICPC Finalist.
profile.summary:
A senior majoring in Computer Science. I have a great interest in Data Science and Algorithm Design, specifically in Runtime and Complexity Analysis, and am open to studying new programming languages. Recently, I have taken a liking to Functional Programming Paradigm, and want to look into its application.

I have nearly 6 years of experience in Competitive Programming with C++ and 3 years of experience in programming in Java and Python. Additionally, for the front end, I mainly used Angular. Recently, I have been studying many functional programming languages, including Scheme, Haskell, and Rust, and looking forward to applying them to personal projects. I am currently interested in the Software Engineering Intern position, specifically in Functional Programming usage.

projects.title: The Race
projects.description: A game coded in Java using the LibGDX framework. The maze for this game was created using a pseudo-randomized depth-first traversal, guaranteeing a novel and different map for every different seed put in. This was a submission to HackCWRU 2020 Hackathon.

projects.title: Puzzle Game Website
projects.description:
A collaborative puzzle game website consists of many different games from participants made by JavaScript, specifically the ReactJS framework.
The team won Second Prize in Hanoi University of Science High School for Gifted Students’ Hackathon 2018.
One of my submissions was awarded as the most complex in generation algorithms.

organizations.name: HackCWRU
organizations.description:
An organization dedicated to Hackathon events throughout the semester.
+ Helping to organize Local Hack Day in Case Western Reserve University.
+ Working on logistics during HackCWRU 2020.
